featured_reviews.review_text:
My wife recently had dental fillings done at this branch. On the second day of treatment, the clinic insisted on an advance payment of ₹3,000 (final balance) before completing the fillings. When I objected — saying it felt unfair to demand full payment before the job was finished — they said it was “the rule here” and pressured us to pay. We reluctantly agreed, though it left us very uncomfortable.
The treating doctor assured us that if the fillings came off or failed within one year, they would redo them free of cost.
Unfortunately, the filling on one tooth dislodged completely within just 4-5 months. When my wife returned for help, they claimed the tooth now required a root canal — a much more expensive procedure — instead of honoring the free replacement promise.
This felt like a clear attempt to extract additional money after providing substandard work. The initial fillings were poor quality, and the clinic’s policies (advance full payment + quick upsell to RCT) left us feeling cheated.
I strongly advise others to avoid this branch. Get a second opinion elsewhere, and be cautious about clinics that demand full payment before completing treatment or give short-lived guarantees. Save yourself the hassle, disappointment, and extra costs we experienced.

owner_posts.post_text: Healthy gums are essential for maintaining strong teeth and a beautiful smile. Regular gum check-ups help reduce the risk of gum disease, control plaque buildup, and support long-term oral health. By detecting and treating gum problems early, you can protect your teeth, maintain better oral hygiene, and prevent more serious dental issues in the future. Schedule your gum check today and take the first step toward a healthier, more confident smile.

Natural-looking teeth bonding is a quick and effective cosmetic dental treatment designed to enhance your smile with subtle yet beautiful results. Using composite material that blends seamlessly with your natural teeth, it helps repair chipped or cracked teeth, close small gaps, and improve overall tooth shape and symmetry. This minimally invasive procedure offers an instant smile transformation while preserving your natural tooth structure. 

Book your consultation today and achieve a brighter, more confident smile with expert teeth bonding.

Replace missing teeth comfortably with custom-fit dentures designed to restore both function and appearance. Dentures help improve speech, chewing ability, and overall comfort while offering an affordable and effective tooth replacement solution. Crafted for a secure, natural-looking fit, they enhance your smile, boost confidence, and help you enjoy everyday activities with ease. Discover how dentures can help you regain a healthy, confident smile.

Early dental care plays a vital role in building a strong foundation for lifelong oral health. Healthy baby teeth support proper growth and development while helping children chew, speak, and smile confidently. Regular dental visits help prevent cavities and tooth pain, make future appointments more comfortable and stress-free, and encourage healthy oral hygiene habits from an early age. Starting dental care early can help ensure healthier smiles and brighter futures for your child.

Invisible braces offer a modern and discreet way to achieve a straighter, healthier smile. They help correct crooked and misaligned teeth, improve bite function, and make it easier to maintain good oral hygiene. By reducing areas where plaque can accumulate, invisible braces can also help lower the risk of cavities and gum disease. Clear, comfortable, and removable, they provide the convenience to eat and clean your teeth with ease while boosting your confidence throughout the treatment journey.

Full mouth dental implants are a long-term and reliable solution for replacing most or all missing teeth. Supported by strategically placed dental implants, they provide fixed and stable teeth that look, feel, and function like natural teeth. This advanced treatment helps restore comfortable eating and speaking, supports jawbone health, and offers a durable alternative to removable dentures. With improved function, appearance, and confidence, full mouth dental implants can significantly enhance your quality of life and help you enjoy a complete, healthy smile once again.

Orthodontic treatment does more than improve the appearance of your smile—it plays an important role in maintaining overall oral health. By correcting crooked, crowded, or misaligned teeth, it helps improve bite function, reduces strain on jaw muscles, and minimizes uneven tooth wear. Properly aligned teeth are also easier to clean, reducing the risk of cavities and gum problems. A healthy bite not only enhances comfort and confidence but also supports long-term dental health.

A root canal treatment is needed when infection or damage reaches the inner pulp of a tooth, causing pain and sensitivity. This procedure helps remove the infection, relieve severe tooth pain, and prevent it from spreading to surrounding tissues. By preserving your natural tooth and restoring normal chewing function, a root canal offers an effective way to protect your oral health and avoid tooth loss. Don’t ignore persistent tooth pain—early treatment can help save your smile and keep your teeth healthy for years to come.

Cosmetic dentistry is generally a safe and effective way to enhance the appearance of your smile when performed by qualified dental professionals. Treatments are carefully planned to suit individual needs, helping to minimize risks and ensure the best possible results. While some patients may experience temporary tooth sensitivity, mild discomfort, or slight gum irritation, these effects are usually short-lived. With proper oral hygiene and regular dental care, cosmetic treatment results can remain beautiful and long-lasting, giving you a healthier and more confident smile.

Composite teeth bonding is a quick and effective cosmetic dental treatment that helps repair chipped teeth, close small gaps, and improve minor imperfections for a more confident smile. The bonding material is carefully matched to your natural tooth colour, providing seamless and natural-looking results. With a comfortable procedure and minimal treatment required, composite bonding offers a simple way to enhance the appearance of your smile beautifully and efficiently.

🦷 Are Chocolates Bad for Teeth?

Not all chocolates are equally harmful!

The real problem isn’t chocolate itself—it’s how much sugar it contains, how sticky it is, and how often it’s eaten.

Better Choices ✅

🍫 Dark chocolate

* Usually contains less sugar
* Melts quickly and doesn’t stick to teeth as much
* Generally a better option than sticky candies

More Harmful Choices ⚠️

🍬 Caramels and sticky chocolates
🍭 Toffees and gummy candies
🍫 Chocolates with gooey fillings that cling to teeth

Tips for Enjoying Chocolate Without Harming Teeth

✔️ Eat chocolate with a meal rather than frequent snacking
✔️ Drink water afterward
✔️ Wait 30 minutes and then brush your teeth
✔️ Maintain regular dental check-ups

Fun Fact!

It’s often better to eat one chocolate bar at once than to keep nibbling on small pieces throughout the day. Frequent sugar exposure gives cavity-causing bacteria more opportunities to attack your teeth.

Remember: It’s not just what you eat—it’s how often you eat it that matters.

🦷 Did You Know? It’s Not Only Sweet Stuff That Causes Cavities!

When we think of cavities, chocolates and candies usually get the blame. But some everyday foods can also increase your risk of tooth decay.

⚠️ Cavity-causing culprits include:
• Chips and crackers
• Bread and biscuits
• Sugary drinks and fruit juices
• Sticky dried fruits
• Frequent snacking throughout the day

Why? Because the bacteria in your mouth feed on carbohydrates and sugars, producing acids that attack your teeth.

✅ Protect your smile:
• Drink water after meals
• Limit frequent snacking
• Brush twice daily
• Visit your dentist regularly

Remember: It’s not just what you eat—it’s how often your teeth are exposed to it!

🌙 Why Is Night-Time Brushing So Important?

Brushing before bed is one of the most important things you can do for your teeth!

During the day, food particles, plaque, and bacteria build up in your mouth. If they’re left overnight, bacteria continue producing acids that attack your teeth while you sleep.

At night:
😴 Saliva production decreases
🦠 Bacteria multiply more easily
⚠️ The risk of cavities and gum disease increases

A quick 2-minute brush before bed helps:
✅ Remove plaque and food debris
✅ Prevent cavities
✅ Protect your gums
✅ Keep your breath fresh
✅ Maintain a healthier smile

Skipping your night brush means giving bacteria 6–8 hours to work on your teeth!

🦷 How to Avoid a Root Canal

The best root canal is the one you never need!

Root canals become necessary when tooth decay or infection reaches the nerve inside the tooth. The good news? Most can be prevented with simple habits.

✅ Brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste
✅ Floss every day
✅ Don’t ignore sensitivity or tooth pain
✅ Visit your dentist every 6 months
✅ Treat cavities early before they become deep
✅ Wear a mouthguard if you grind your teeth
✅ Limit sugary snacks and drinks

Small cavities are easy to treat.
Waiting can lead to pain, infection, and root canal treatment.

Remember: Prevention is always easier, faster, and more affordable than treatment.

🦷 What Is a Root Canal?

A root canal is a treatment used to save a tooth when the soft tissue inside it (called the pulp or nerve) becomes infected or inflamed.

This can happen due to:
⚠️ Deep cavities
⚠️ Cracked or broken teeth
⚠️ Repeated dental procedures
⚠️ Trauma or injury to the tooth

During a root canal treatment:
✅ The infected tissue is removed
✅ The inside of the tooth is cleaned and disinfected
✅ The space is sealed to prevent reinfection
✅ A crown is often placed to strengthen the tooth

Myth: Root canals are painful.
Fact: Modern root canal treatment is usually no more uncomfortable than getting a filling and helps relieve pain caused by infection.

The biggest benefit?
✨ It allows you to keep your natural tooth instead of removing it.

🦷 Why Is an OPG / Full Mouth X-Ray Important?

Your teeth may look healthy on the surface, but some dental problems can only be detected with an X-ray.

An OPG (Orthopantomogram) or Full Mouth X-ray provides a comprehensive view of your teeth, jaws, wisdom teeth, jaw joints, and surrounding bone structures.

✅ Detect hidden cavities and infections
✅ Evaluate wisdom teeth position
✅ Assess bone levels and gum health
✅ Identify impacted teeth and jaw abnormalities
✅ Assist in planning implants, braces, and extractions
✅ Monitor overall oral health

Many dental conditions develop silently without causing pain. Early detection through an OPG can help prevent more complex problems in the future.

✨ Early Detection. Better Treatment. Healthier Smiles.

A healthy smile starts with healthy habits. Daily brushing, flossing, smart food choices, and regular dental check-ups help prevent cavities, gum disease, and other oral health issues. Good oral hygiene not only protects your teeth but also supports your overall health and confidence.

✅ Brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste
✅ Floss daily to remove plaque between teeth
✅ Choose tooth-friendly foods and stay hydrated
✅ Schedule routine dental check-ups and cleanings

📍 Visit Tru Dental, Mumbai, for expert dental care and a healthier smile.

👶🦷 Is Thumb Sucking Affecting Your Child’s Smile?

Thumb sucking is a natural habit in infants and young children. However, when it continues beyond the age of 4–5 years, it can begin to affect the growth and development of the teeth and jaws.

Prolonged thumb sucking may lead to:
❌ Protruding front teeth
❌ Increased overjet (“buck teeth”)
❌ Open bite (front teeth don’t meet)
❌ Changes in jaw growth
❌ Speech difficulties

The earlier the habit is addressed, the easier it is to prevent long-term dental problems.

At Tru Dental Clinic, we help parents identify early signs and guide children toward healthy oral development.

✨ Healthy habits today create confident smiles tomorrow.

Not flossing daily can affect more than just your breath.

Plaque and bacteria between the teeth can slowly lead to gum problems, cavities, and sensitivity.

A simple flossing routine helps maintain better oral hygiene and supports long-term dental health
